# Sanad in Dahab - Mural and Street Art Portfolio

## About
Sanad is a professional muralist, illustrator, and street artist based in Dahab, South Sinai, Egypt. He specializes in creating vibrant, custom wall paintings and graffiti for camps, hotels, restaurants, and private spaces across the Red Sea region. His artwork bridges modern urban graffiti culture with traditional Egyptian and Bedouin heritage, resulting in stunning large-scale murals that transform environments.

## Services & Expertise
- Custom Murals & Wall Paintings
- Street Art & Graffiti
- Interior & Exterior Decor (Camps, Hotels, Cafes, Beach Houses)
- Bedouin and Bohemian Style Art
- Marine and Underwater Inspired Art
- Large Scale Facade Painting
- Canvas Art and Illustrations

## Location
Based in Dahab, South Sinai, Egypt. Available for commissions throughout Sinai (Nuweiba, Sharm El Sheikh, Taba) and mainland Egypt (Cairo, Alexandria).

## Contact Information
- Website: https://sanadtheartist.art
- Region: South Sinai, Egypt

## Style & Approach
Sanad's work is characterized by vibrant colors, dynamic compositions, and a deep connection to local environments. Whether it is an underwater scene depicting the rich marine life of the Red Sea or a geometric pattern inspired by Bedouin textiles, each piece is custom-designed to elevate the space it occupies.

## Key Themes
- Red Sea & Marine Life (Turtles, Dolphins, Coral Reefs)
- Desert Landscapes & Mountains
- Boho-Chic & Hippie Culture
- Egyptian Heritage & Contemporary Arabic Typography
